LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: The Snow Queen
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: The Snow Queen (F-01-37) marks workers with an icy Kiss (50% Normal / 100% Bad) and seals twice-kissed victims inside a 90-second ice coffin, locking normal work.\nWin her Rescue Duel (Fortitude 10%–100%) to thaw the prisoner and exclusively earn her frost-blossom E.G.O. Gift for both hero and captive.
